headline: Your bone age
subhead: IS MEASURED FROM THE WRONG BONES

headline: I have received a number
body: saying that a hand X-ray tells you exactly how much growth you have left because all your growth plates close at the same time but this is just purely wrong. | Different bones in the same body close at completely different times and the hand is the one that closes first which is why using it to read your legs does not work.
punch: Your hand is not where your height comes from

headline: The small bones
body: When looking at the study by Dolan in PLOS Biology you can see that in mice *epiphyseal fusion* which is the growth plate disappearing happens at about **3 weeks** in the phalanges and **4 weeks** in the metacarpals but the tibia and femur still have not fused at **12 weeks** | and in rats it is the exact same order **12 weeks** phalanges **16 weeks** metacarpals and the legs still open so this is not a one animal thing
punch: _The finger bones close while the leg bones are barely started_

headline: They also grow
body: You might argue that the hand bones just finish earlier but we also need to understand that they are slower the entire time. At one week the metacarpal growth rate was **49%** of the tibial rate and *proliferation per column* was **46%** | which is why every marker of *growth plate senescence* which is the plate running out of divisions was more advanced in the hand bones than the legs at the same age
punch: ==Your hand bones grow at half the speed of your legs==

headline: The reason
body: This is actually the most important part. They took *chondrocytes* out of finger bones and leg bones and the finger cells divided slower but when they added IGF-1 to the finger cells proliferation rose **to match the untreated leg cells** | so the difference is not the bone it is how much growth signal actually reaches the plate which is why the hand ages faster
punch: The bone is the same the signal is not

headline: Lets look at
body: Kvist 2021 did MRI on **958 people** aged 14 to 21 and imaged the wrist knee and ankle in the same person and found that fusion timing varied by site inside one body and complete fusion happened about **2 years earlier** in girls | and *pubertal stage* correlated with fusion at every site **0.514 to 0.598** in males so where you are in puberty is what actually tracks it

headline: And here is where
body: The same study tested physical activity directly and found no significant correlation in males at any site and in females one very low correlation at the wrist **0.095** and nothing else | but **BMI** did correlate 0.186 to 0.384 which means the thing everyone tells you spends your plates did not move them and body composition did

headline: So what do you
body: Read your bone age as an estimate from your fastest ageing bones not your legs and track your pubertal stage because that is what actually correlated with fusion | and remember the hand finishes first always
